documents.title: Documents
documents.help: Registration, insurance, kasko, inspection and emission documents are kept with their history; the record of each type with the latest end date is the current one.
documents.dialog_description: Enter the document details; you can attach the scan (PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP).
documents.file_hint: At most 10 MB. The server checks the file type from its content.
documents.file_too_large: The file cannot be larger than 10 MB.
documents.empty_description: Add the vehicle's registration, insurance, kasko and inspection documents.
documents.delete_description: The {{type}} record will be removed from the list.
maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.help: Planned maintenance is tracked by date or km target; completing a plan marks the same record as done.
maintenance.plan_description: Enter a date and / or km target; it is reminded 15 days or 1,000 km before.
maintenance.record_description: Record a completed maintenance with its date, km and cost.
maintenance.complete_description: The plan is marked as done on the same record.
maintenance.empty_description: Plan a maintenance or record one that was done.
maintenance.delete_description: The {{type}} record will be removed from the list.
